title: Setting extension ownership and routing

source_classes.canonical_effect: May establish setting facts only at the scope and confidence supported by the source.
Reusable environment/archetype evidence; no named-setting instantiation without explicit evidence or governed authoring.
Proposal/template/generator input only; never canonical by generation alone.

ownership_routes.content: World/Setting identity, typed hierarchy, source-backed setting membership, world-local extension scope
Campaign/Scene instantiation, current world state, branching preparation/live/post-session authoring
Creature/NPC core definitions and playable Creature semantics
Item/equipment/inventory core definitions and Asset semantics
Vehicle/mecha/starship core definitions and instance semantics
Species/Form/biology core definitions and Character biological state

ownership_routes.owner: Feature Bible Exploration / downstream PPIA-08 integration

allowed: explicit relation in a retained source
explicit governed authoring decision with provenance
validated import/migration preserving explicit source relation

setting_local_mechanics.universal_promotion: requires separate explicit authority and owning-domain validation

unknown_conflict_policy.conflict: retain competing assertions/revision identity until governed resolution
unknown_conflict_policy.draft_revision: do not silently merge older/current/new statements

authoring_policy.accepted_authoring: must record author, scope, provenance, validation and version

permission_policy: Filter hidden/unrevealed setting facts before counts, search, maps, route results, summaries, warnings, exports, diagnostics, notifications, or AI context.
accessibility_policy: Every hierarchy, route, environment, reveal, conflict and authoring operation must be usable without relying solely on map position, color, hover, drag, animation, or visual geometry.
